name: Editor export menu offers PPTX, PDF and HTML exports that trigger downloads
description: The editor Export menu exposes the export formats and clicking PPTX triggers a file download without an error toast.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the app root URL /, stay on the 'Studio — structured' tab, type the brief 'Onboarding playbook for new customer success hires' into the 'A · Brief' textarea and click 'Forge the outline'.
Wait for the 'Outline proposal' view, then click 'Approve & write N slides' and wait until the editor opens (allow up to 120 seconds).
Open the Export menu in the editor toolbar.
Verify the export menu lists PowerPoint/PPTX, PDF, HTML and image (PNG) export options and the primary options are enabled.
Click the PPTX / PowerPoint export option.
Verify a success toast or download event occurs (a .pptx file download starts) and no error toast appears. Allow up to 60 seconds for the file to be produced.
Open the Export menu again and click the HTML export option.
Verify a download or success feedback occurs and no error toast appears.
